description: Get or set 3-tier stealth mode, applied on next navigation. Tiers: 'regular' (default; no anti-fingerprint patches), 'stealth' (light: navigator.webdriver, chrome.runtime, permissions), 'undetected' (full: plugins, WebGL vendor, Worker patch). Omit tier to read current mode. 'regular' suits most sites; escalate to 'undetected' (most fingerprint entropy) only for hard anti-bot targets.

tier.description: Stealth tier to set ('regular', 'stealth', 'undetected'). Omit to read current tier.

name: browser_mode
